y281088f4df2.add: - **Largest UT:** **Ladakh** (since 2019); among the older UTs **Delhi (~1,483 sq km)** > Puducherry (~490) > Chandigarh (114) > Daman and Diu (111).

ya31235ab4e5.add: - **Seven Sisters:** **Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura** (+ Sikkim = 8 North-Eastern States); **West Bengal is not** one.

yae8185e1659.add: - **Daman and Diu** lie on either side of the **Gulf of Khambhat** (Daman on the mainland coast, Diu off Saurashtra); capital **Daman** (also of the merged UT DNH and DD since 2020).

y4f74ef5568f.add: - **States and UTs:** **28 States and 8 UTs** (since 26 Jan 2020; **7 UTs before 2019**, 9 from 31 Oct 2019): Delhi, Chandigarh, Puducherry, Lakshadweep, A&N, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, J&K, Ladakh.

ycc0639ee525.add: - **Rohingya:** Muslim minority of **Myanmar** (Rakhine); refugees in Cox's Bazar (Bangladesh) and India.

y0297769b079.add: - **Mean sea level (exam key):** India's MSL is measured from tide-gauge data at **Chennai** (Survey of India).

y2039c0b3f97.add: - **Lakshadweep:** formerly the **Laccadive, Minicoy and Amindivi** islands, renamed **1973**; lies off the **Malabar** (not Coromandel) coast.
